name: Context Engineering Skills
tagline: Agent skills for context engineering, multi-agent architectures, and production agent systems.
description: Comprehensive collection of agent skills for context engineering and multi-agent system development. Covers context management, multi-agent architectures, prompt engineering, agent optimization, and production deployment patterns. Designed for building, optimizing, and debugging agent systems that require effective context management. Includes best practices for prompt design, context window optimization, and agent coordination.
